tags.name: Little Wall
tags.validation_note: Coordinates place this site immediately adjacent to Mnemba Island's Big Wall. Dive-shop sources describe a companion 'Small Wall' at Mnemba reaching 30-40m, but no source uses the literal name 'Little Wall', so the identification is not confirmed. Fewer than 3 independent sources found for this exact site name; not marked validated.

tags.name: Big Wall
tags.validation_note: Confirmed by 5 independent sources as a deep advanced wall east of Mnemba Island. Reported maximum depth varies by source (55m-70m technical range; zentacle.com is an outlier reporting 25m/intermediate and was not used). depth field set to 40m as the recreational-limit figure; the wall continues well beyond that per every corroborating source.

tags.name: Barracuda Point
tags.validation_note: Coordinates and the one confirmed source place this site in South East Zanzibar (Paje/Jambiani), not Nungwi as the prior markdown claimed -- that location error has been corrected. Only 1 independent source found describing the site itself; not marked validated.

tags.name: Lagoon Mounding
tags.validation_note: Only 1 independent source found (6-22m range); not marked validated.

tags.name: Stingray city
tags.validation_note: 2 independent sources found (still short of the 3-domain bar). Species corrected: sources describe blue-spotted stingrays (Indo-Pacific), not the Caribbean/Atlantic southern stingray species named in the prior write-up.

tags.name: Jambiani Lagoon
tags.validation_note: Only 1 independent source found; not marked validated.

tags.name: Cement wall
tags.validation_note: 3 independent sources confirm the site and general depth profile (6-40m tiered wall/garden). A '1930s cement-cargo ship / anchors' origin story repeats across tourism blogs but PADI's own dive-site database entry does not mention it and describes only a natural coral wall -- treated as unverified local lore in the markdown, not stated as fact.

tags.name: Sau Inn Garden
tags.validation_note: Only 1 independent source found (two pages on the same operator domain); not marked validated.

tags.name: Pawoni Hill
tags.validation_note: 2 independent sources found (still short of the 3-domain bar). Listed by operators as one of three 'Powoni' sites (North/Hill/South).

tags.name: Woo south
tags.validation_note: Only 1 independent source found. That source reports a much wider depth range (12-75m, shallow coral heads transitioning to a deep drop-off) than the previous 18m entry; depth corrected upward but not marked validated.

tags.name: Memba 1
tags.validation_note: No source found under this name. Coordinates are ~150m from 'Little Wall' and within the same Mnemba Island reef system -- possible near-duplicate from overlapping scraper passes; flagged for dedup review rather than merged/removed here.

tags.name: Memba 2
tags.validation_note: No source found under this name. Located within the Mnemba Island reef system alongside Memba 1/Little Wall/Big Wall.

tags.name: Napoleon Wall
tags.validation_note: 2 independent sources found (still short of the 3-domain bar), consistently reporting a 12-35m drop-off named for a resident Napoleon wrasse.

tags.name: Moore Bank
tags.validation_note: No corroborating source found (dive shop listings, forums, or nautical charts) despite extensive search. Located in the Kizimkazi/Menai Bay area based on coordinates. Content trimmed to avoid unsupported claims.

tags.name: Pungume Patches
tags.validation_note: 1 independent source found ('Pungume Reef', 10-30m, drift diving for experienced divers, rays and seasonal whale sharks). Pungume Island itself is well documented by general tourism sources but not as a scuba site specifically. Difficulty raised from Intermediate to Advanced per the one dive-specific source.
